repo_notes.content: Enterprise is a homemade intranet built on Ruby on Rails 2.3.14 / Ruby 1.8.7 — a classic pre-Bundler Rails app using script/* helpers, config/environment.rb, prototype.js/scriptaculous JavaScript, and .example config files that must be renamed on install (config/database.example.yml, config/environment.example.rb, config/initializers/mail.example.rb, app/models/error_mailer.example.rb, app/models/user_mailer.example.rb). Only the will_paginate gem is listed as a dependency.

Functionally it is a family/personal intranet covering several domains: bookmarks shared via RSS/XML feeds, a recipe system (recipes, ingrediences, units, meals), a shopping system (lists, purchases, locations), a media/movie database (movies, programs), plus CMS-like pages and categories. Authentication and role-based authorization come from lib/authenticated_system.rb with User/Role/Permission models.

Notable legacy characteristics for documentation: erb/rhtml/rxml views plus RSS and atom builders, multiple device stylesheets (iphone.css, n95.css, psp.css, lcars.css), dispatch.cgi/dispatch.fcgi entrypoints in public/, seeded lookup data under db/migrate/data/, and tests organized as test/unit and test/functional with YAML fixtures. A recent commit modernized password hashing to salted SHA-256 and hardened prototype.js helpers.

pages.title: Kitchen Domain

pages.title: Media and Feeds

pages.title: Pages, Categories, and Misc Resources
